events.title: ESP32 iPhone Agent turns a low-cost HID board into a phone-control bridge
events.title_zh: ESP32 iPhone Agent 用低成本 HID 板桥接真机操作
events.summary: ESP32 iPhone Agent publishes an MIT-licensed loop that streams an iPhone screen over AirPlay, asks an OpenAI-compatible vision model to choose actions, and sends taps, drags, typing and keys through an ESP32-S3 acting as USB HID. It avoids Xcode, a developer account, a signed phone app and jailbreak, but still requires a host, an ESP32-S3 and a cloud or local vision model.
events.summary_en: ESP32 iPhone Agent publishes an MIT-licensed loop that streams an iPhone screen over AirPlay, asks an OpenAI-compatible vision model to choose actions, and sends taps, drags, typing and keys through an ESP32-S3 acting as USB HID. It avoids Xcode, a developer account, a signed phone app and jailbreak, but still requires a host, an ESP32-S3 and a cloud or local vision model.
events.summary_zh: ESP32 iPhone Agent 公开一套 MIT 许可的真机操作闭环：通过 AirPlay 获取 iPhone 画面，让兼容 OpenAI API 的视觉模型决定动作，再由 ESP32-S3 以 USB HID 发送点击、拖动、输入和按键。它不需要 Xcode、开发者账号、签名应用或越狱，但仍要准备主机、ESP32-S3 和云端或本地视觉模型。
events.why_it_matters: For mobile-agent teams, a roughly US$7 physical I/O bridge lowers the setup barrier for real-device computer-use experiments and avoids depending on a signed automation stack. The author demos do not establish reliability, so the project should remain on WATCH until independent users reproduce calibration, recovery and emergency-stop behavior across apps.
events.why_it_matters_en: For mobile-agent teams, a roughly US$7 physical I/O bridge lowers the setup barrier for real-device computer-use experiments and avoids depending on a signed automation stack. The author demos do not establish reliability, so the project should remain on WATCH until independent users reproduce calibration, recovery and emergency-stop behavior across apps.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对移动端 agent 团队来说，约 7 美元的物理 I/O 桥接降低了真机 computer-use 实验门槛，也避开了签名自动化栈。作者演示不能证明可靠性；在独立用户跨应用复现校准、恢复和紧急停止前，先保持 WATCH。

events.title: Littleguys 0.2 adds live Claude Code sessions and an encrypted phone bridge
events.title_zh: Littleguys 0.2 接入 Claude Code 实时会话与加密手机桥接
events.summary: Littleguys 0.2 turns the local control surface into a live Claude Code supervisor. It can start, resume and stop sessions, relay approvals and render commands, files and diffs. A phone bridge uses Noise IK pairing and encrypted local or Tailscale transport for remote control.
events.summary_en: Littleguys 0.2 turns the local control surface into a live Claude Code supervisor. It can start, resume and stop sessions, relay approvals and render commands, files and diffs. A phone bridge uses Noise IK pairing and encrypted local or Tailscale transport for remote control.
events.summary_zh: Littleguys 0.2 把本地控制台扩展成 Claude Code 实时监督界面。它可以启动、恢复和停止会话，转发审批，并展示命令、文件与 diff。新增的手机桥接用 Noise IK 配对，通过局域网或 Tailscale 加密传输进行远程控制。
events.why_it_matters: For developers supervising long-running local agents, this is a material step beyond a status menu. The phone bridge and approval relay also widen the trust boundary, and no independent security or scheduler-durability review was found.
events.why_it_matters_en: For developers supervising long-running local agents, this is a material step beyond a status menu. The phone bridge and approval relay also widen the trust boundary, and no independent security or scheduler-durability review was found.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对监督长时运行本地 agent 的开发者来说，这已经不只是状态菜单。手机桥接和审批转发也扩大了信任边界，本轮仍未找到独立安全审计或调度持久性验证。

events.title: AutoTrust publishes JEV-35B for one-pass ranking decisions
events.title_zh: AutoTrust 发布单次排序决策模型 JEV-35B
events.summary: AutoTrust AI released Apache-2.0 weights for JEV-35B, a Qwen3.5-35B-A3B fine-tune for ranking up to 256 options in one pass. The model card reports a self-scored public benchmark and a 204 ms median on one B200. The full benchmark is mostly private, the result is not a board entry and no independent deployment evidence is available.
events.summary_en: AutoTrust AI released Apache-2.0 weights for JEV-35B, a Qwen3.5-35B-A3B fine-tune for ranking up to 256 options in one pass. The model card reports a self-scored public benchmark and a 204 ms median on one B200. The full benchmark is mostly private, the result is not a board entry and no independent deployment evidence is available.
events.summary_zh: AutoTrust AI 发布 JEV-35B 的 Apache-2.0 权重。这是基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的微调，可一次排序最多 256 个选项。模型卡报告自测公开 benchmark 和单张 B200 上 204 ms 中位延迟；完整 benchmark 大部分不公开，该结果也不是榜单正式记录，尚无独立部署证据。
events.why_it_matters: One-pass ranking could simplify recommendation pipelines, but a self-scored public subset cannot establish an advantage over established rerankers or task-specific classifiers. The current evidence does not justify a trial.
events.why_it_matters_en: One-pass ranking could simplify recommendation pipelines, but a self-scored public subset cannot establish an advantage over established rerankers or task-specific classifiers. The current evidence does not justify a trial.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 单次排序可能简化推荐流水线，但公开子集自测不能证明它优于成熟 reranker 或任务分类器。现有证据不值得投入试验。
